lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a semi-regular grid pattern across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibiting sharp vertical luminance gradients (bright upper edge, dark lower shadow) are visible along the upper-lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) attached to the lower-left flank, visible as a high-contrast, slender horizontal silhouette.
